title: Back to Lanin and the Johnson inauguration
summary: After his gall bladder trouble Moore returned to Lanin, and Lanin, Armstrong and Guy Lombardo played the same inauguration.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: So after you came out of the hospital and recuperated from your gall bladder, you went back on the Lester Lanin society circuit and then you also had your own bands intermittently, your own groups?
Yeah, we were playing for -- inauguration for Lyndon Johnson and I was with Louie this time and Lester had his band, too. So we all were in the same room altogether, the two bands. And Guy

Lombardo was there, the third band and so Lester asked me, he said, "How long are you going to keep running around the country? You know, people ask about you. Are you going to come back to us when you get through with Armstrong?" I said, "I'll keep that in mind because I'm going to retire now."
So the next time -- as I said, when I had my gall bladder attack I was with Lester back in New York. So this time I've been with Lester all the time.

And the world doesn't owe me a thing. I've been in places and I've gotten things and I love everybody in the world. The musicians treated me right and everybody trombone player that's younger than me I'd always say, "You're going to be the son of Chief."
